scope_outcomes.criterion: A position is eligible when the text itself undertakes a scoped proposition about an object, including its conditions, rather than merely attributing that proposition to a cited work or opponent.
scope_outcomes.basis: The inspected sections contain explicit first-person statements of the speaker’s disciplinary standpoint, analytical claims about capitalism, markets, religion, money, and society, and a concluding normative position.
limitations: The assessment concerns positions undertaken in the supplied text and does not independently inspect the cited works.
